quotes: “ My Friend .— Welcome to the Carpathians . I am anxiously expecting you . Sleep well to-night . At three to-morrow the diligence will start for Bukovina ; a place on it is kept for you . At the Borgo Pass my carriage will await you and will bring you to me . I trust that your journey from London has been a happy one , and that you will enjoy your stay in my beautiful land .
“ Must you go ? Oh ! young Herr , must you go ? ”
“ Do you know what day it is ? ”
“ Oh , yes ! I know that ! I know that , but do you know what day it is ? ”

“ It is the eve of St. George 's Day . Do you not know that to-night , when the clock strikes midnight , all the evil things in the world will have full sway ? Do you know where you are going , and what you are going to ? ”
